about.title: About AI Life Summary
about.subtitle: Discover the story behind the technology that helps millions understand themselves better
about.what.title: What We Do
about.what.p1: AI Life Summary is a birthday-based entertainment tool. It uses a deterministic hash to select components from fixed narrative templates and create a shareable sentence.
about.what.p2: The result is a creative prompt for reflection and conversation, not a personality analysis, factual insight, or prediction.
about.what.p3: Use the sentence lightly: share it, discuss it, or leave aside anything that does not resonate.
about.mission.title: Our Mission
about.mission.p1: At the heart of AI Life Summary lies a simple yet powerful mission: to help people pause, reflect, and connect with themselves and others in meaningful ways. In our fast-paced digital world, moments of genuine self-reflection have become increasingly rare. We believe that a single, well-crafted sentence can serve as a catalyst for deeper thinking about who we are and what we value.
about.mission.p2: Beyond individual reflection, we aim to foster connection between people. When friends, family members, and colleagues share and compare their life summaries, conversations naturally deepen. These shared experiences create bonds and understanding that might not otherwise emerge in everyday interactions.
about.mission.p3: We're committed to maintaining a positive, uplifting tone in all our generated content. Every sentence in our database has been carefully crafted to highlight strengths, acknowledge challenges constructively, and inspire growth. We believe that everyone has unique gifts and that our platform should celebrate, rather than diminish, the human spirit.
about.how.title: How Our Technology Works
about.how.p1: The system converts your birthday into a deterministic hash and uses that value to select sentence components from fixed narrative templates.
about.how.p2: The components are written and reviewed for clarity, positivity, and broad relatability.
about.how.p3: The same birthday produces the same result. This repeatability does not establish a scientific or psychological connection between a birth date and personality.
about.how.p4: We review and expand the sentence templates as editorial content. The algorithm remains a deterministic entertainment mechanism, not a research-based assessment.
about.note.title: A Note on Our Service
about.note.p1: AI Life Summary is designed primarily for entertainment and personal reflection. While many users find genuine insight in their results, we want to be transparent that our algorithm is not based on scientific personality assessment methods or predictive analytics.
about.note.p2: The power of our service lies not in any claim to psychological accuracy, but in its ability to prompt meaningful self-reflection and conversation. A well-crafted sentence, even one generated algorithmically, can serve as a mirror that reflects aspects of ourselves we may not have consciously considered.
about.note.p3: We encourage users to approach their results with an open mind, taking what resonates and leaving what doesn't. The best use of AI Life Summary is as a starting point for reflection, not as a definitive statement about who you are.
about.faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
about.faq.q1: Is my data stored or shared?
about.faq.a1: No. Your birthday is processed entirely in your browser using our client-side algorithm. We do not transmit, store, or share any personal information. Your privacy is completely protected.
about.faq.q2: Why do I get the same result every time?
about.faq.a2: Our algorithm is deterministic, so the same birthday produces the same output. That repeatability is a property of the calculation, not evidence of a connection between birth date and personality.
about.faq.q3: Can I use my results commercially?
about.faq.a3: Personal sharing on social media is encouraged and welcomed. For commercial use, please contact us to discuss licensing options.
about.faq.a4: AI Life Summary is designed for entertainment and reflection, not scientific accuracy. Many users find their results surprisingly relevant, but we encourage you to take what resonates and enjoy the experience without expectations.
about.faq.q5: Is there a mobile app available?
about.faq.a5: Our website is fully responsive and works beautifully on mobile devices. We don't currently have a dedicated app, but you can add our site to your home screen for an app-like experience.
about.faq.a6: We love hearing from our users! Please visit our Contact page to share your thoughts, suggestions, or experiences with AI Life Summary.
